description: This file implements the App2AppProvider class, which provides a plugin for app-to-app discovery and messaging within the WPEFramework. It includes registration of JSON-RPC endpoints, handling app registration, messaging, configuration, and state management.

classes.name: App2AppProvider
classes.description: A plugin class providing app-to-app discovery and messaging functionalities, including registration, messaging, configuration, and event notification.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service shell, reads configuration, and sets the initial state.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, clears state, and unregisters endpoints.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin version information.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC endpoints for plugin functionalities.

methods.name: endpoint_ping
methods.description: Responds with 'pong' to a ping request.

methods.name: endpoint_getInfo
methods.description: Provides plugin information including name, version, state, provider ID, and capabilities.

methods.name: endpoint_configure
methods.description: Configures plugin settings such as enabled state, provider ID, and capabilities.

methods.name: endpoint_sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message from one app to another if the recipient is registered.

methods.name: event_statechanged
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a change in plugin state.

methods.name: event_appregistered
methods.description: Notifies listeners that an app has been registered.

methods.name: event_appunregistered
methods.description: Notifies listeners that an app has been unregistered.

methods.name: event_message
methods.description: Notifies listeners of a message event.

methods.name: RegisterAppInternal
methods.description: Internal method to register an app by appId.

methods.name: UnregisterAppInternal
methods.description: Internal method to unregister an app by appId.

methods.name: IsRegistered
methods.description: Checks if an app is registered.
